```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(readxl)
})
set.seed(42)
```

```{r paths_and_parameters}
# ---- Paths ----------------------------------------------------
base_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/pcgr_outputs"
out_dir  <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/Variant_classification"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

run_date       <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
VAF_THRESHOLDS <- c(0.03, 0.05)   # fractions (3% and 5%)

# ---- Non-silent classes (same list as the WES script) ---------
INCLUDE_SPLICE_REGION <- TRUE     # set FALSE for a stricter list
nonsilent_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation", "Nonsense_Mutation", "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins", "In_Frame_Del", "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site", "Translation_Start_Site"
)
if (INCLUDE_SPLICE_REGION) {
  nonsilent_classes <- c(nonsilent_classes, "Splice_Region")
}

# Keep 'Silent' rows too, only so the audit can show what was excluded
classes_to_read <- c(nonsilent_classes, "Silent")

# Excel CONSEQUENCE terms that change the protein or splice site.
# A row containing 'synonymous_variant' but none of these = silent.
protein_altering_terms <- paste(
  "missense_variant", "frameshift_variant", "stop_gained", "stop_lost",
  "start_lost", "inframe_insertion", "inframe_deletion",
  "protein_altering_variant", "splice_acceptor_variant",
  "splice_donor_variant", sep = "|"
)

# Only the MAF columns we need (the full file has 116 columns)
maf_cols <- c(
  "Hugo_Symbol", "Chromosome", "Start_Position", "Variant_Classification",
  "Variant_Type", "Reference_Allele", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2",
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "HGVSp_Short", "FILTER"
)
```

```{r helper_functions}
clean_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

# Build one normalized key (chr:pos:ref:alt) so MAF and PCGR variants
# written in different styles (MAF "-" alleles vs VCF anchor base) match.
edit_key <- function(chr, pos, ref, alt, maf_format = FALSE) {
  chr <- sub("^CHR", "", toupper(trimws(as.character(chr))))
  pos <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(pos))
  ref <- toupper(trimws(as.character(ref)))
  alt <- toupper(trimws(as.character(alt)))

  if (anyNA(c(chr, pos, ref, alt)) || !nzchar(chr) || pos < 1L ||
      !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", ref) || !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", alt)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  # MAF insertions (REF = "-") use the left-flank position
  if (maf_format && ref == "-") pos <- pos + 1L
  if (ref == "-") ref <- ""
  if (alt == "-") alt <- ""

  # Strip identical PREFIX first (shifts position), then identical suffix.
  # Prefix-first reproduces the MAF representation of VCF-style indels.
  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) && substr(ref, 1, 1) == substr(alt, 1, 1)) {
    ref <- substring(ref, 2)
    alt <- substring(alt, 2)
    pos <- pos + 1L
  }
  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) &&
         substr(ref, nchar(ref), nchar(ref)) == substr(alt, nchar(alt), nchar(alt))) {
    ref <- substr(ref, 1, nchar(ref) - 1L)
    alt <- substr(alt, 1, nchar(alt) - 1L)
  }

  if (!nzchar(ref) && !nzchar(alt)) return(NA_character_)
  paste(chr, pos, ifelse(nzchar(ref), ref, "-"), ifelse(nzchar(alt), alt, "-"), sep = ":")
}

# Parse PCGR GENOMIC_CHANGE, e.g. "16:g.68808447AGAATT>A"
pcgr_genomic_key <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return(NA_character_)
  hit <- regmatches(
    x,
    regexec("^(?:chr)?([^:]+):g\\.([0-9]+)([ACGTN]+|-)>([ACGTN]+|-)$",
            x, perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )[[1]]
  if (length(hit) == 5L) return(edit_key(hit[2], hit[3], hit[4], hit[5]))
  NA_character_
}
```

```{r read_all_samples}
sample_ids <- list.dirs(base_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
cat("Samples found:", length(sample_ids), "\n")

maf_list <- vector("list", length(sample_ids))
pcgr_list <- vector("list", length(sample_ids))
maf_totals <- vector("list", length(sample_ids))
names(maf_list) <- names(pcgr_list) <- sample_ids

for (i in seq_along(sample_ids)) {
  s <- sample_ids[i]
  maf_file <- file.path(base_dir, s, paste0(s, ".pcgr.grch38.maf"))
  xls_file <- file.path(base_dir, s, paste0(s, ".pcgr.grch38.xlsx"))

  # ---- MAF: read needed columns, keep coding classes only ----
  maf <- fread(maf_file, sep = "\t", skip = "Hugo_Symbol", select = maf_cols,
               na.strings = c("", ".", "NA"))
  if (!all(maf$Tumor_Sample_Barcode == s)) {
    warning("Barcode differs from folder name in: ", s)
  }
  maf_totals[[i]] <- data.table(Sample_key = s, n_maf_rows = nrow(maf))
  maf <- maf[Variant_Classification %in% classes_to_read]
  maf[, Sample_key := s]
  maf_list[[i]] <- maf

  # ---- PCGR Excel: VAF + CONSEQUENCE ----
  xls <- as.data.table(read_excel(xls_file, sheet = "SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL",
                                  guess_max = 100000))
  need <- c("SYMBOL", "GENOMIC_CHANGE", "VAF_TUMOR", "CONSEQUENCE")
  if (length(setdiff(need, names(xls)))) {
    stop("Missing Excel columns in ", s, ": ",
         paste(setdiff(need, names(xls)), collapse = ", "))
  }
  pcgr_list[[i]] <- xls[, .(
    Sample_key         = s,
    PCGR_SYMBOL        = clean_gene(SYMBOL),
    CONSEQUENCE        = as.character(CONSEQUENCE),
    GENOMIC_CHANGE     = as.character(GENOMIC_CHANGE),
    VAF_TUMOR_fraction = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(VAF_TUMOR)),
    Variant_key        = vapply(GENOMIC_CHANGE, pcgr_genomic_key, character(1))
  )]
}

maf_totals <- rbindlist(maf_totals)
maf_all    <- rbindlist(maf_list)
pcgr_dt    <- rbindlist(pcgr_list)

# VAF must be a fraction between 0 and 1 (confirmed on the first sample)
if (any(pcgr_dt$VAF_TUMOR_fraction < 0 | pcgr_dt$VAF_TUMOR_fraction > 1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  stop("VAF_TUMOR outside 0-1 detected: check whether some files use percent.")
}
if (anyNA(pcgr_dt$Variant_key)) {
  warning(sum(is.na(pcgr_dt$Variant_key)), " PCGR rows had an unparseable GENOMIC_CHANGE.")
}

# Flag Excel rows that are silent at the protein level
pcgr_dt[, Excel_synonymous_only :=
          grepl("synonymous_variant", CONSEQUENCE) &
          !grepl(protein_altering_terms, CONSEQUENCE)]
pcgr_dt[, Match_key := paste(Sample_key, Variant_key, sep = "|")]

# Collapse duplicated PCGR rows of the same sample + variant
pcgr_vaf <- pcgr_dt[!is.na(Variant_key), .(
  VAF_TUMOR_fraction   = if (all(is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction))) NA_real_
                         else median(VAF_TUMOR_fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
  Excel_synonymous_only = all(Excel_synonymous_only),
  PCGR_SYMBOL          = PCGR_SYMBOL[1],
  CONSEQUENCE          = CONSEQUENCE[1],
  PCGR_rows            = .N
), by = Match_key]
```

```{r match_maf_to_pcgr}
# Normalized key for each MAF row (only ~50k coding rows, so this is fast)
maf_all[, Variant_key := mapply(
  edit_key, Chromosome, Start_Position, Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
  MoreArgs = list(maf_format = TRUE), USE.NAMES = FALSE
)]
maf_all[, Hugo_Symbol_clean := clean_gene(Hugo_Symbol)]
maf_all[, Match_key := paste(Sample_key, Variant_key, sep = "|")]

maf_vaf <- merge(maf_all, pcgr_vaf, by = "Match_key", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

maf_vaf[, matched := !is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction)]
maf_vaf[, gene_mismatch := matched & !is.na(PCGR_SYMBOL) &
                           Hugo_Symbol_clean != PCGR_SYMBOL]

# Final non-silent flag: MAF class AND not synonymous-only in PCGR
maf_vaf[, is_nonsilent := matched &
          Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes &
          !Excel_synonymous_only]

# ---- Sanity checks (please paste these outputs back) ----
cat("\nCoding-class MAF rows:", nrow(maf_vaf),
    "| matched to PCGR:", sum(maf_vaf$matched),
    "| gene-label mismatches:", sum(maf_vaf$gene_mismatch), "\n")

cat("\nFILTER values of matched variants:\n")
print(maf_vaf[matched == TRUE, .N, by = FILTER][order(-N)][1:10])

cat("\nMAF class vs PCGR synonymous-only flag (matched rows):\n")
print(maf_vaf[matched == TRUE, .N, by = .(Variant_Classification, Excel_synonymous_only)][order(-N)])

# PCGR variants not found among the kept MAF rows (possible key failures
# or variants whose MAF class is intron/UTR/etc.)
pcgr_not_in_maf <- pcgr_vaf[!Match_key %in% maf_vaf$Match_key]
cat("\nPCGR variants without a matching coding MAF row:", nrow(pcgr_not_in_maf), "\n")
print(pcgr_not_in_maf[, .N, by = CONSEQUENCE][order(-N)][1:10])

fwrite(maf_vaf[, .(Sample_key, Hugo_Symbol, PCGR_SYMBOL, Variant_Classification,
                   CONSEQUENCE, Chromosome, Start_Position, Reference_Allele,
                   Tumor_Seq_Allele2, FILTER, VAF_TUMOR_fraction, matched,
                   gene_mismatch, Excel_synonymous_only, is_nonsilent)],
       file.path(out_dir, paste0("Full_MAF_nonsilent_variant_PCGR_VAF_match_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")),
       sep = "\t", na = "NA", quote = FALSE)
fwrite(pcgr_not_in_maf,
       file.path(out_dir, paste0("PCGR_variants_not_in_MAF_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")),
       sep = "\t", na = "NA", quote = FALSE)
```

```{r gene_tables_per_threshold}
total_samples <- length(sample_ids)

# Per-sample counts at each filtering stage (used for the dropped-sample report)
stage <- data.table(Sample_key = sample_ids)
stage <- merge(stage, maf_totals, by = "Sample_key", all.x = TRUE)
counts <- maf_vaf[, .(
  n_coding_class_rows = sum(Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes),
  n_matched_PCGR      = sum(matched),
  n_nonsilent_matched = sum(is_nonsilent)
), by = Sample_key]
stage <- merge(stage, counts, by = "Sample_key", all.x = TRUE)
for (col in c("n_coding_class_rows", "n_matched_PCGR", "n_nonsilent_matched")) {
  set(stage, which(is.na(stage[[col]])), col, 0L)
}

for (thr in VAF_THRESHOLDS) {
  lab <- sprintf("VAFge%dpct", round(thr * 100))

  passing <- maf_vaf[is_nonsilent == TRUE & VAF_TUMOR_fraction >= thr &
                       !is.na(Hugo_Symbol_clean)]

  # ---- Samples dropped at this threshold, with the reason ----
  stage[, n_pass_VAF := passing[, .N, by = Sample_key][match(Sample_key, Sample_key), N]]
  stage[, n_pass_VAF := passing[.SD, on = "Sample_key", .N, by = .EACHI]$N]
  dropped <- stage[n_pass_VAF == 0, .(
    Sample_key,
    Reason = fcase(
      n_maf_rows == 0,           "MAF file is empty",
      n_coding_class_rows == 0,  "no coding non-silent class rows in MAF",
      n_matched_PCGR == 0,       "no MAF variant matched to a PCGR VAF",
      n_nonsilent_matched == 0,  "all matched variants are silent",
      default = paste0("all non-silent variants have VAF < ", thr * 100, "%")
    )
  )]

  cat("\n=====", lab, "=====\n")
  if (nrow(dropped)) {
    cat("Samples dropped (no passing variant):\n")
    print(dropped)
  } else {
    cat("No samples dropped: all", total_samples, "samples have >= 1 passing variant.\n")
  }

  retained_samples <- uniqueN(passing$Sample_key)

  # ---- Gene-level summary ----
  gene_summary <- passing[, .(
    Mutated_Samples = uniqueN(Sample_key),
    Variant_Count   = .N,
    Median_VAF_Percent = round(100 * median(VAF_TUMOR_fraction), 2),
    Variant_Classification = paste(sort(unique(Variant_Classification)), collapse = ";")
  ), by = .(Hugo_Symbol = Hugo_Symbol_clean)]

  gene_summary[, Frequency_Percent_retained_samples :=
                 round(100 * Mutated_Samples / retained_samples, 2)]
  gene_summary[, Frequency_Percent_all_samples :=
                 round(100 * Mutated_Samples / total_samples, 2)]

  setcolorder(gene_summary, c(
    "Hugo_Symbol", "Mutated_Samples", "Frequency_Percent_retained_samples",
    "Frequency_Percent_all_samples", "Variant_Count",
    "Median_VAF_Percent", "Variant_Classification"
  ))
  setorder(gene_summary, -Mutated_Samples, -Variant_Count, Hugo_Symbol)

  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(
    "Full_MAF_nonsilent_", lab, "_gene_mutation_frequency_", run_date, ".tsv"))
  fwrite(gene_summary, out_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "NA")

  cat("Retained samples:", retained_samples, "of", total_samples, "\n")
  cat("Non-silent variants:", nrow(passing),
      "| genes:", nrow(gene_summary), "\nSaved:", out_file, "\n")
  print(head(gene_summary, 20))
}

fwrite(stage, file.path(out_dir, paste0("Per_sample_filtering_stages_", run_date, ".tsv")),
       sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
```
